text: During maintenance diagnostics, the air traffic control software shall mask the personal identities of crew and passengers in any data shown to the maintenance engineer.
The hospital patient-record system shall exchange patient data with external clinics only through an encrypted communication channel.
The online booking system must allow an administrator to run a verification of the stored reservation records that reports any record that has been altered since it was saved.
The database server shall run an anti-malware scanner that inspects uploaded files and backup imports and quarantines any file detected as malicious.

The screen capture tool shall end the active recording session and lock the application when no user input has been received for a configurable idle interval, limiting exploitation of an unattended session.
The hospital patient-record system shall use a distinct encryption key for each participating clinic so that one clinic's key can never decrypt another clinic's patient records.
The online booking system shall allow only staff with reservation-management privileges to create, modify or cancel bookings on behalf of customers.
The screen capture tool must grant integrated applications access only to the windows and screen regions they are actively authorised to record, and hide the remaining screen content.

The screen capture tool shall let a user register a recovery email address and shall only allow the account to be regained after the user proves control of that address through a single-use confirmation link.
The database server shall grant write and delete permissions on production tables solely to accounts that have been explicitly assigned a data-modification privilege.
The smart-home IoT controller shall verify the embedded ownership mark of each firmware image offered by different vendors and reject any image whose mark has been modified.
The smart-home IoT controller shall propagate a revoked or updated user credential to all paired hubs and mobile apps so that each one authenticates the user only with the current credential.
The compiler shall validate that every build configuration option holds a value of its declared type within its permitted range and shall abort the build when any option fails this check.
The hospital patient-record system shall allow only users holding the physician role to amend a diagnosis entry, and it must reject amendment attempts from every other role.
The smart-home IoT controller shall let each connected app read only the device states needed for that app's purpose and conceal every other household sensor reading.
The online booking system must cancel a pending reservation and notify the user of the failure when the signed booking reference, date or price is found to have been manipulated.

The payroll and human resources management system must enforce a reset of an employee's login credential across all of its modules, including the time-sheet and benefits portals, so that identity checks always use the latest credential.
The payroll and human resources management system must restrict edits to salary and bank-account records to staff members whose role grants payroll update rights.
The simulation software shall compute a cryptographic digest of each input scenario file on import so that later changes to the file can be detected.
The compiler shall require a developer to present valid credentials before it accepts a build request on the shared build service.
The web browser shall validate the signature of its installed extensions and settings store at each launch and shall block any item that has been altered without authorisation.
The database server must refuse to write a value into a column when the value does not conform to the column's declared type, and must keep the stored row unmodified.
The database server shall assign each hosted customer its own encryption key hierarchy so that data encrypted for one customer remains unreadable to every other customer.
The web browser must transmit page requests and responses over an encrypted transport protocol so that eavesdroppers on the network cannot read their content.
The forecasting system shall detect tampered historical sales data with a documented maximum rate of incorrect tampering reports, so that analysts can trust the reported data accuracy.
The smart-card electronic purse shall accept a cardholder's PIN or passphrase for card activation only when it provides at least 64 bits of strength.
The screen capture tool shall prevent any process other than the authorised capture session from modifying or deleting recordings that have already been saved.
The hospital patient-record system shall reject any clinical data exchange message whose nonce or sequence counter duplicates one already accepted from the same sending device.
The sales forecasting system must restrict write access to historical sales figures to authorised analysts so that unauthorised users cannot change the figures used in forecasts.
The simulation software shall detect any alteration of an input scenario file between its release by the model author and its loading for execution.

The smart-home controller must require a new household member to present a unique identifier and a pairing credential, and must confirm that the person is an invited resident before enrolling the member's account.

The database server shall enforce a documented data-protection rule that lists which tables and fields hold personal or business-critical content and limits their viewing to explicitly permitted roles.
The online booking system shall protect each confirmed reservation record with a message authentication code that is verified before the record is displayed or processed.
The online banking application must embed a hidden tamper-evident mark in each generated account statement so that any modification of the statement can be detected.
The database server shall return query results only for the tables and rows that the requesting account has been granted permission to read.
The electronic purse must keep the integrity mark in its transaction records detectable after the records are copied, compressed or deliberately edited in an attempt to erase the mark.
The online booking system shall erase the memory buffers holding a customer's payment details before releasing them so that no later session can read residual values.
The web browser must permit modification of enterprise policy settings solely by a signed-in device administrator and must refuse such changes from ordinary profiles.
The smart-home IoT controller must require each person using the mobile app to present a registered account name and its matching credential before it accepts any device command.
